instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz mit dem Verb im simple past.
instruction.sound: Fervollständige den Satz mit dem Werb im <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>simple past</lang>

atoms.b: A mouse ((creep creeps ++crept)) quietly across the floor.
He ((kneels ++knelt kneel)) as he did the laundry.
My friends ((stick ++stuck sticking)) to the plan yesterday.
Yesterday, Jarrett's finger ((swell swollen ++swelled)) a little after a bug bite.

It seemed like her arm ((swelled)) overnight.
